title: Nashville 1BR With Resort Access
description:
Make Nashville your home base in Nashville, Tennessee. This one-bedroom retreat welcomes up to 4 guests across 1 bedroom and 1 bathroom. Guests enjoy pools to cool off in, a soothing hot tub, an on-site gym, and shared grilling areas on the grounds, with plenty to explore nearby.

The space
Inside, you'll find a fully equipped kitchen, in-unit laundry, and complimentary Wi-Fi, with space for 4 across 1 sleeping area. The resort adds pools to cool off in, a soothing hot tub, an on-site gym, and shared grilling areas for everyone to share.

Guest access
Please have a valid credit card ready at check-in for the refundable damage deposit (final amount confirmed on site). The primary guest needs to be 21 or older with valid ID; sharing their info early keeps things moving at arrival. Exact bedding can differ from unit to unit and can't be promised beforehand, and applicable occupancy taxes are collected at check-in or departure.

Other things to note
Photos reflect the resort's overall style and setting; your specific suite may look a little different. You'll have full use of the amenities for your entire stay, arrival and departure days included. Units are assigned at check-in and specific buildings or locations can't be guaranteed. This is a private stay hosted by an individual timeshare owner — we're independent of resort management and simply help owners offset maintenance costs during unused weeks. You may receive an optional invitation to a timeshare presentation; it's entirely optional and easy to decline. Guests agree to the resort's own rules and any applicable fees at check-in, and only the cancellation policy shown on this booking applies.
